clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Ilthalaine keeps watch over the sacred glade and guides young night elves as they begin their lives in Teldrassil. He teaches them to defend their home and tend its balance.

Ilthalaine watches the woodland paths just outside Shadowglen's heart. He sees changes in the forest that ordinary eyes miss. When young night elves awaken to their duties, he welcomes them and grounds them in Kaldorei traditions. His guidance prepares them to care for Teldrassil and shoulder the responsibilities of its defenders.

Heavy spring rains have brought more nightsabers and thistle boars to Shadowglen than the glade can feed. Ilthalaine asks young defenders to thin their numbers, leaving room for the woodland's other creatures to flourish and restoring nature's balance.

Ilthalaine tests young elves against local wildlife and points them toward their chosen callings. He gives each traveler a class sigil and directs them to their mentors in the Aldrassil sanctuary. Warriors, druids, rogues, priests, and hunters all find where their service to the Kaldorei begins.
